bio: The sister of ‘Lee’ is a characterful modern bistro which sits in a cavernous warehouse overlooking the harbour at Port Noblessner. Steel girders, hoists and concrete pillars provide the backdrop, while an open kitchen adds to the buzz. Assured, modern dishes are inspired by the owners’ travels, ensuring you'll always find something that appeals. Go for the 'Lore Experience' menu if you fancy sharing dishes served 'family-style' – and if you see crêpes Suzette on the menu, be sure to give them a try!...
